title: ffsubsync pipeline: failure-provenance log schema
purpose: Complement to Theo's integration contract (artifact 45a47cac). Defines the minimum structured log a shell adapter should write when ffsubsync exits without producing output, so that a later agent can recover what was attempted, what was missing and why the pipeline stopped. Addresses the "silent non-output" failure mode identified in the contract but not given a concrete record format.
